title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: kinds of loss paid and temperature claim conditions by tier
content:
## Scope

This coverage grid belongs to the Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims product line. It shows, for every tier, the kinds of loss the product pays and the reefer-related figures held for temperature damage claims.

## Kinds of loss the product pays

| Tier | Physical damage | Wet damage | Temperature damage | Contamination | Shortage | Total loss | Delay loss |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Standard Carrier Liability | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No |
| AHL Declared Value Liability | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No |
| AHL CargoCare Essential | Yes | Yes | No | No | Yes | Yes | No |
| AHL CargoCare Plus | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No |
| AHL CargoCare Premium | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No |
| AHL CargoCare Total | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

## Temperature damage figures

| Tier | Lowest reefer service tier rank for temperature damage | Logged temperature excursion needed | Minimum continuous excursion logged |
|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Standard Carrier Liability | 1 | Yes | 180 minutes |
| AHL Declared Value Liability | 1 | Yes | 180 minutes |
| AHL CargoCare Essential | 1 | Yes | 180 minutes |
| AHL CargoCare Plus | 2 | Yes | 120 minutes |
| AHL CargoCare Premium | 1 | No | 0 minutes |
| AHL CargoCare Total | 1 | No | 0 minutes |

## Definitions

- **Kinds of loss the product pays**: the kinds of loss, as named on a notice of loss, that the tier pays.
- **Lowest reefer service tier rank**: the lowest tier rank of the reefer service, as ranked in the reefer charter, under which temperature damage is covered.
- **Logged temperature excursion needed**: whether a temperature claim needs a logged temperature excursion on the reefer service.
- **Minimum continuous excursion logged**: the minimum continuous excursion, in whole minutes, logged for a temperature claim when a logged excursion is needed.

## Points of judgement

**Which tier pays delay loss?** Only AHL CargoCare Total.

**Does AHL CargoCare Essential pay contamination?** No; its grid row shows No for contamination and for temperature damage.

**On AHL CargoCare Plus, how long must a logged excursion last?** At least 120 continuous minutes, and the reefer service rank must be at least 2.
